projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.sub: A showcase of full-stack applications built to solve complex problems and deliver seamless user experiences.

work1.description: TechBlog is a lightweight, frontend-focused blog application engineered to demonstrate core React fundamentals. Built strictly with TypeScript for type safety, it features seamless client-side navigation using React Router DOM. Component state and asynchronous data fetching are handled entirely through native useState and useEffect hooks, dynamically rendering content pulled from a third-party REST API.

work2.description: A full-stack Student Management CRM engineered with secure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). The application dynamically routes users to dedicated Admin or Student dashboards upon authentication. Built with React and TypeScript, it leverages the Context API for global state management and React Hook Form for seamless data entry. Admins can execute complex CRUD operations, manage courses, and control user permissions, while students can track their academic details—all seamlessly powered by an Appwrite backend.

work3.description: A comprehensive airline reservation platform featuring distinct portals for passengers and administrators. Users can book round-trip or one-way flights, dynamically manage seat assignments post-reservation, complete web check-ins, and generate digital boarding passes. The admin dashboard offers advanced CRUD capabilities for flight scheduling, centralized booking management, and real-time revenue analytics. Engineered with Next.js and TypeScript, the application leverages TanStack Query and Redux Toolkit for sophisticated state management, alongside React Hook Form and Zod for rigorous data validation. The interface is highly polished using shadcn/ui and Magic UI components.
